notes_for_editor: Date of present tower disputed: 1962 (LF), 1964-65 (heritage record), 1969 (Rowlett); heritage record itself says the 1905 building was decommissioned 1962. Keeper list is Lighthouse Friends' compilation (cites Livingstone 2002), overlaps unresolved; only Bell checked in primary report (1910-11 volume, matched by column position). The 1905 report places the lighthouse on the extremity of the cape; Rowlett's 'Cousins Shore' is the later moved site. Ownership differs: LF says Land Trust since May 2016, Rowlett says CCG (older). The heritage record's trust-transfer sentence is ambiguous about which building. Brief's 'first_lit 1965' and deactivated 1965 look wrong/unsourced. Commons/Parks Canada page was not readable.
